title: Hearty Gooey Ethiopian Almond Tart
description: This Ethiopian-inspired tart features almond flour and is free from refined sugars, making it a great option for those looking for a sweet treat without the guilt. It's earthy, gooey, and energizing, perfect for a dessert or snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the almond flour, melted coconut oil, and raw honey, stirring until well combined.
Add the eggs one at a time, stirring well after each addition, followed by the vanilla extract and salt.
Press the mixture into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Arrange the mixed berries on top of the tart mixture, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
If using sesame seeds, sprinkle them over the berries.
Bake the tart for 40 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool completely on a wire rack.
Once cooled, refrigerate the tart for at least 2 hours to allow it to set before serving.
